# permio_group (Data Source)

Looks up a group and its members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "permio_group" "engineering" {
  name = "engineering"
}

output "engineering_members" {
  value = data.permio_group.engineering.members
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name (slug).

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `members` (Set of String) Principal IDs of the group's members.
- `principal` (String) Principal ID to grant to: `group:<name>`.
